svg.title: Corridor race: Architect's technical section
svg.desc: Corridor race (2D): the service passage drawn as a technical-pen long section, the 14 m the camera sees. The player runs east from 404 toward 405, whose rose has brightened because its guest is home; between them, dimensioned and hatched, lie the four loose boards that creak if run over. A key plan above shows the whole 64 m passage and where this view sits in it.
svg.text: A LOOSE BOARDS: RUNNING CREAKS +25 TO ROOMS WITHIN 12 m.
WALK, CRAWL OR HOP. 405 ROSE LIT: GUEST HOME, BELL x5.
